The short version: Reacher is software that automates your TikTok Shop creator outreach for roughly $199 to $599 a month, and you run it. Tokgency is a managed agency that runs the whole creator program and is accountable for the GMV. If you have an operator with time, Reacher is a strong tool. If you want the outcome without building the function, that is where an agency wins.

Here is the fair breakdown.

This is the real fork, and operators doing serious volume land on the same side of it. The founder of a brand that is number one in its category and on track for $35 million on TikTok Shop this year warned that most brands "blast out thousands of affiliate DMs, hope something sticks, and wonder why growth plateaus," and that the fix is to "go deep on affiliate relationships, not wide" (@brock_mammoser on X). A tool automates the blasting. A managed program does the going-deep. Keep that in mind as you compare.

What Reacher is

Reacher is a well-built TikTok Shop affiliate outreach platform. It connects to the Affiliate Center and gives you:

  • AI creator search over a 3M+ creator database
  • Automated outreach across DM, Target Collaboration, and email with follow-ups
  • AI sample-request review and a creator CRM
  • A "Reacher AI Agent" on higher tiers

Pricing runs from around $199/mo (Starter) to about $599/mo (Pro). It is genuinely useful if you have someone to drive it.

What Tokgency is

Tokgency is a TikTok-only growth agency plus a creator-discovery tool. Instead of handing you software, we run the program: recruiting, seeding, negotiation, briefs, management, ads, and reporting, measured on GMV driven. The self-serve creator finder is available if you want to search yourself, but the core offer is done-for-you.

The real difference

Reacher Tokgency
Model DIY software Managed agency (+ tool)
You provide The operator and the judgment A product and a goal
Priced on Monthly seat (~$199 to $599) Flexible, commission-friendly
Accountable for Features delivered GMV driven
Creator database 3M+ Yes, plus managed recruiting
Best when You have creator-ops capacity You want the outcome, not the tool

Reacher automates the sending. It does not decide who to target, what to offer, how to brief, or which winners to scale. That judgment is the actual work, and with a tool it stays on your plate.

The honest cost comparison

A $599/mo Pro plan looks cheaper than an agency until you add the person running it 10 to 15 hours a week. A tool nobody has time to operate drives $0. Weigh total cost, software plus labor, against a managed program measured on results.

When Reacher is the better pick

  • You already have a creator manager who enjoys the daily grind.
  • You want full control and in-house ownership.
  • Your volume justifies a dedicated tool and you have the hours.

When Tokgency is the better pick

  • You are past first sales and stuck scaling affiliates and reviews.
  • You do not want to hire and train a creator-ops function.
  • You want someone on the hook for GMV, not message-sent counts.

Neither is "better" in the abstract. Reacher is the right answer when you have the operator. Tokgency is the right answer when you want the program run for you. If you are still deciding between tooling and a team, read TikTok affiliate management: DIY, software, or agency.

Want a straight answer for your shop? Book a call and we will tell you honestly whether a tool like Reacher is enough, or try the creator finder to see who sells in your niche first.
